criteria.text: Given a bare git push that is not granted, When the wall asks, Then the prompt includes the diff summary (files and counts)
Given a non-interactive run, When a push happens, Then no diff summary is added
Given a push under a live ship grant, When it runs, Then the push ASK and its summary do not appear
Given diff-summary is asked for the full diff, When run with the full flag, Then it outputs the actual changed lines
Given the ship preview, When it is shown, Then it includes the diff summary and the approve question offers Show full diff
Given nothing to show, When a push has no changes, Then no summary is added
